text:
maya (support): Heads up — multiple orgs reporting token cost on the dashboard showing $0 or NaN. Found 4 orgs so far: org_981, org_1102, org_1189, org_1210. Screenshot: https://redwood.screens/xyz :frowning:
sam (eng-ml): Can you paste the org IDs and the exact filter you used? Also, is this only embedders or all usage metrics?
maya (support): Filter: product=\"inference\" AND date>=2026-02-01. Both generation and embedding metrics. Query returns rows with token_count but cost_per_token = NULL for those orgs.
julie (billing): If cost_per_token is NULL then aggregated_cost comes back NULL -> dashboard shows blank or NaN depending on charting. Any recent price map changes for new enterprise plans?
alejandra (prodops): I pulled the price_map join for those orgs.
alejandra (prodops): ```sql
SELECT o.org_id, p.price_usd_per_token, p.effective_at
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN price_map p ON p.plan_id = o.plan_id AND p.effective_at <= '2026-02-28'
WHERE o.org_id IN ('org_981','org_1102','org_1189','org_1210');
```
alejandra (prodops): Result: price_usd_per_token is NULL for org_1102 and org_1210. Looks like the price_map entry for the new enterprise plan (plan_e_x) wasn't inserted due to a migration race.
sam (eng-ml): That would explain NaN (NULL * tokens). Why $0 though for some views? Maybe dashboard's timeseries uses COALESCE(sum(cost),0) in one pipeline and charting library shows 0 for missing values.
maya (support): Customer affected (org_1102) just pinged support — wants invoice estimate. Need guidance on short-term fix.
julie (billing): Short term: set fallback price = org.default_price or last_known_price. Patch analytics query to `COALESCE(p.price_usd_per_token, o.default_price, 0)` and mark those orgs for manual verification. Long term: backfill price_map and re-run aggregator.
sam (eng-ml): I'll push a guarded query patch to the reporting worker to avoid nulls showing as $0/NaN in the UI. Also will kick off a one-off backfill job for affected date range.
alejandra (prodops): I checked analytics pipeline logs. cost-agg-worker crashed on 2026-03-05 03:14 UTC with:
alejandra (prodops): ```
ERROR cost-agg-worker: Failed to write aggregated_costs - foreign key constraint violation on price_map_insert
Traceback: IntegrityError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint
```
alejandra (prodops): Crash coincided with a deploy that modified price_map schema — some write operations aborted and left gaps.
ops-bot: deploy: cost-agg-worker v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 triggered by @sam (eng-ml) at 2026-03-05T03:10:12Z :rocket:
sam (eng-ml): I'll roll forward the consumer fix and deploy a hotfix to fallback to `o.default_price` when `p.price_usd_per_token` is NULL. Also creating a migration script to insert missing price_map rows from billing history.
julie (billing): Please create a short incident note and flag invoicing team. We should notify the four affected orgs and mention we are re-running cost aggregation and will provide an interim estimate.
maya (support): Drafted message to affected orgs, asked for any urgent invoice requests. Pasting draft below:
maya (support): "Hi — we identified a data issue causing your token cost estimate in the console to appear as $0/blank. We're patching the reporting pipeline and will re-run the aggregation for the past 30 days. If you need an immediate invoice, reply and we will prioritize. Sorry for the confusion. — Redwood Support"
sam (eng-ml): ETA for patch/deploy: 30–45 mins. Backfill job estimate: 1–2 hours (depends on lookback). I'll post follow-ups.
alejandra (prodops): Backfill job started at 2026-03-05T04:05Z. Monitoring for errors.
julie (billing): After backfill completes, let's verify invoice numbers for org_1102 and org_1210.
maya (support): Thanks team. I'll keep thread updated and mark higher priority for customers who reply. :thumbsup:
